name: Hornwood Inc.
old_description: Based in Lilesville, North Carolina, Hornwood Inc. has been in continuous operation since 1946. The company takes tremendous pride in supporting the Armed Services of the United States by manufacturing a complete spectrum of American-made, Berry-Compliant military grade textiles. Built for the greatest military on earth, Hornwood textiles provide our service members with the world-class level of performance they deserve to execute their missions.
about:
Hornwood Inc. operates from Lilesville, North Carolina, where it has run continuously since 1946. The company is US-owned and operated, though the input does not name its founders or specify a family, veteran, or woman-owned structure.

The manufacturer produces tricot and circular knit fabrics for a range of markets. Its output includes Berry-Compliant military-grade textiles for the U.S. Armed Services, the Game Time Fabrics line of athletic uniform materials used from youth leagues to professional teams, and protective textiles for oil and gas, fire service, electrical, and utility workers. Production relies on in-house knitting capabilities, an internal lab and research center, and advanced manufacturing techniques for inherently flame-retardant yarns.

Hornwood serves the defense sector, the athletic and activewear apparel market, and industrial safety segments including oil and natural gas, fire services, electricians, and utility companies. Customers include the U.S. military, sports apparel brands, and industrial safety distributors.

The company emphasizes its Berry Amendment compliance, domestic manufacturing footprint, and in-house R&D as differentiators. It also highlights community involvement through school tutoring programs and scholarships.
